# Embedded MDX syntax parser

`parser.js` is generated by `node writr-rs/tools/gen-mdx-parser.mjs` from the
already-installed remark-mdx dependency graph. `versions.json` and
`LICENSES.txt` record every bundled package. `gen-all.mjs` verifies freshness
in CI. No third-party package versions were added or upgraded.

Rust's MDX tokenizer calls the same Acorn/JSX parser and events-to-Acorn adapter
as the JS oracle, running in the existing QuickJS library. It validates source
strings only: user expressions, function bodies and imported modules never
execute. Import bindings are validated against completed MDX AST blocks so
speculative tokenization cannot mutate module scope. UTF-16 diagnostic offsets
are translated to UTF-8 byte offsets before returning to markdown-rs.

Each rendering thread lazily retains one syntax-parser context. Parsed source
and output are not cached. This adds parser initialization and MDX rendering
cost; no performance improvement or benchmark parity is claimed.
